result: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 server.rs source shows tasks/get, tasks/update and tasks/cancel are capability-gated in Service<RoleServer>::handle_request and then dispatched as get_task(GetTaskParams, RequestContext<RoleServer>), update_task(UpdateTaskParams, RequestContext<RoleServer>) and cancel_task(CancelTaskParams, RequestContext<RoleServer>).
